description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProgressChartPresenter class, which renders a mini bar chart for displaying calorie intake over the last 7 days within an Android TV application. It creates a custom view with styled bars and labels, drawing the chart onto a bitmap and setting it in an ImageCardView.

classes.name: ProgressChartPresenter
classes.description: A presenter class for rendering a mini bar chart of calorie data over the last 7 days, styled for TV display.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates and initializes the view holder containing an ImageCardView with specific styling and dimensions.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds data to the view holder by drawing a bar chart bitmap representing calorie entries over the last 7 days.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Clears the image bitmap from the view when unbinding.
